errors.not_paired: Add this fan again so Homey can learn your handset.
errors.tx_failed: Homey could not transmit. Check the app log.
errors.light_off: Turn the light on first — its brightness controls do nothing while it is off.

pair.title: Add fan
pair.listening: Press a button on your handset
pair.listening_hint: Hold the Lucci handset near Homey and press any button, so Homey can learn which fan it belongs to.
pair.timeout: Homey didn't hear a press from a Lucci handset. Move the handset closer to Homey and try again.
pair.found_hint: Next, add your fan. Homey can now send it the same codes as the handset — but the fan reports nothing back, so what Homey shows is what it last commanded or overheard.
pair.not_learned: Homey hasn't learned your handset yet. Go back and press a button on it.
pair.found_hint_light: Next, add your light. Homey can send it the same codes as the handset — but the light reports nothing back, so brightness is tracked rather than known. Calibrate it any time from Settings → Maintenance → Try to Repair.
pair.timeout_restored: Homey heard a Lucci handset but never a complete signal, so it could not be sure of the address. Move the handset closer to Homey and try again.

calibrate.title: Calibrate brightness
calibrate.intro_hint: The light never reports its level, so Homey counts presses and the count can drift. Driving the light all the way to one end puts it right, because it stops there rather than wrapping around. Pick an end; the light must be on.
calibrate.running_hint: Handing the presses to the radio.
calibrate.started_hint: This takes about {{seconds}} seconds. You can close this; Homey will keep going and knows where the light ends up.
